title: Cleartext ws:// URL (universal) — review required
description: Code references a cleartext WebSocket URL: ws://[A-Za-z0-9]. Frames to it are readable and modifiable by network observers. This lexical rule flags the literal; the reviewer confirms the channel is non-sensitive or upgrades it.

limitation: Lexical, line-based: matches the scheme regardless of channel sensitivity.
